scripts.render: hyperframes render --fps 60 --quality delivery --format mp4 --video-frame-format png --keyframe-interval 2 --crf 20 -o renders/hive-product-demo.mp4
scripts.poster: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -ss 0.65 -i renders/hive-product-demo.mp4 -frames:v 1 renders/hive-product-demo-poster.png && /opt/homebrew/bin/cwebp -quiet -q 90 renders/hive-product-demo-poster.png -o renders/hive-product-demo-poster.webp
